verdict.rationale: Square documents a Payouts API with a List Payouts endpoint (square-docs-25), which gives payout data a merchant could reconcile against. The only other support is a generic 'Manage your cash flow' marketing line (square-docs-23). Nothing in the pack shows itemized transaction or fee reports, or any reconciliation tooling that matches daily takings to payouts. Missing for 10: itemized fee reporting, payout-entry or transaction-level breakdown of each payout, daily sales-vs-payout reconciliation reports, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
